description: Pre-spend check before a payment service is called: per-payment and daily limits, blocked categories, a merchant allow-list and an approval threshold, plus a Caelara Shield screen of the merchant domain; answers allow, escalate or block with plain-English reasons and a hash-only signed clearance receipt, and opens a single-use one-tap approval on escalate. Never pays and never moves money. Heuristic screening — will miss attacks

amount.description: Amount about to be spent, greater than 0

category.description: Spend category, e.g. travel or gambling

currency.description: ISO 4217 code (USD) or a short asset symbol

destination_hash.description: Or the SHA-256 of the destination, computed by the caller (64 hex)

merchant_domain.description: Merchant domain, screened by Caelara Shield (send this or destination_hash)

rules.description: Spend rules: { max_per_tx?, daily_cap?, spent_today?, allow_domains?: [domains or destination hashes], block_categories?: [], require_hitl_above? } (may be empty)

name: guard__spend_check
